title: ShutdownServer
description: This is a plugin that shuts down your server in an emergency
body:
### What about this plugin
  **This is a plugin that shuts down your server in an emergency.** For example, fake player DDoS attack， or detonates a large amount of TNT.You can shut down the server using a preset password
### How to use?
   First,download this plugin and copy it to your server's plugin folder。</br>
   Second,restart your server </br>
   Third,Edit the password option for the profile </br>
   Finally, restart the server.
